messages:
maya: Quick heads-up — PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/service/pull/9123 has a hotfix for the kv-cache hang. Cutoff for the patch window in ~45m. We need two approvals to merge. Can @alex or @sam take a look?
alex: I can do the first review, giving me ~10m.
sam: I can be second if integ tests are green. Will peek shortly.
deploy-bot: CI status for PR #9123 — unit ✅, lint ✅, integ ⚠️ (flake). Rerun queued.
maya: thanks. if integ keeps flaking we may cherry-pick the minimal fix to release branch, but prefer straight merge.
alex: quick pass done — found a lint nit and one comment about a race condition, pushed a tiny change in a separate commit. Rerunning CI.
alex: LGTM (after lint fix). Added :eyes: on integ.
sam: saw alex's change, running a local smoke too. I left one optional comment but overall OK to approve. Giving my +1 now. :thumbsup:
maya: Perfect — that's two approvals. I'm tagging for merge if deploy-bot green.
deploy-bot: Merge requested by maya. Merge blocked: required approvals = 2. Current approvals: alex, sam.
maya: scheduling canary once merged. Canary window 15 minutes on release edge. ops-oncall, FYI.
ops-oncall: noted. Canary slot at 15:00 UTC is free. Make sure feature flag is toggled for gradual rollout.
maya: toggled flag: `features.kv_hotfix_canary = true` (will flip off on rollback).
tyler: can't review now, will validate post-merge in staging. If anything goes sideways I can help rollback.
maya: thanks. merging in ~3m once final CI is green.
deploy-bot: All checks passing. Merge completed by maya. Canary deployment started.
observability-bot: Canary metrics (5m): error rate 0.02% (baseline 0.05%), latency p95 down 3%. No kv-cache regressions detected in traces.
maya: awesome — closing this thread. Thanks for the quick eyes everyone.
sam: nice work :rocket:
alex: thanks, good teamwork.
notes: Thread is a short coordination exchange around a blocking approval need for a hotfix; includes CI bot and observability bot messages.
